title: Conversation header permanently displays Completed state after turn completes
description: In EnabledWorkspace, when a turn finishes with turn.completed, turnStatus is set to 'completed' and is never cleared. visibleTurnState permanently displays 'Completed' in the conversation header until switching channels.

comments.author: box
comments.text:
Triage 2026-09-14 (Chatticus): CONFIRMED live + code.

Live on https://dev.chattic.us/chat with AcceptLoopBot: after turn finished, conversation header kept showing “Completed” without switching channels.

Code (`web/components/EnabledWorkspace.tsx`): on `turn.completed`, `setTurnStatus("completed")` then clears `turn`/`progress`, but never resets `turnStatus` to null. `visibleTurnState` therefore stays `"completed"` until `selectItem`. Fix: clear `turnStatus` (and preferably drop the completed presentation) after reconcile, or auto-clear after a short delay / on next idle.
